place.summary: Temple Street Night Market functions primarily as a connector in Hong Kong's visitor network. Its strongest observed source market is TH. It receives notable inbound connections from Sha Tin Che Kung Temple. Visitors often continue to Sha Tin Che Kung Temple. It performs above its category average on observed experience.
